blocks.en: \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]\item Define a multiplication operator $M:C_b([0,1])\to C_b([0,1])$ by\[M(u)(x):=xu(x),\]for every $u\in C_b([0,1])$. Describe $\sigma(M)$.\item Let $v\in C_b([0,1])$ be given. Define an operator $M_v:C_b([0,1])\to C_b([0,1])$ by\[M_v(u)(x):=v(x)u(x),\]for every $u\in C_b([0,1])$. Describe $\sigma(M_v)$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh: \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]\item 对每个 $u\in C_b([0,1])$, 用下式定义乘法算子 $M:C_b([0,1])\to C_b([0,1])$:\[M(u)(x):=xu(x),\]描述 $\sigma(M)$.\item 给定 $v\in C_b([0,1])$. 对每个 $u\in C_b([0,1])$, 用下式定义算子 $M_v:C_b([0,1])\to C_b([0,1])$:\[M_v(u)(x):=v(x)u(x),\]描述 $\sigma(M_v)$.\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:continuous-multiplication-operator-spectrum

blocks.en:
Suppose that $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ is an extension of a bounded operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$. Show the following:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $\sigma_p(\widetilde A)\supset\sigma_p(A)$.
\item $\sigma_r(\widetilde A)\subset\sigma_r(A)$.
\item $\sigma_c(A)\subset\sigma_c(\widetilde A)\cup\sigma_p(\widetilde A)$.
\item $\rho(\widetilde A)\subset\rho(A)\cup\sigma_r(A)$.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.zh:
假设 $(\mathcal{D}(\widetilde A),\widetilde A)$ 是有界算子 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 的扩张. 证明以下结果:\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
\item $\sigma_p(\widetilde A)\supset\sigma_p(A)$.
\item $\sigma_r(\widetilde A)\subset\sigma_r(A)$.
\item $\sigma_c(A)\subset\sigma_c(\widetilde A)\cup\sigma_p(\widetilde A)$.
\item $\rho(\widetilde A)\subset\rho(A)\cup\sigma_r(A)$.
\end{enumerate}
blocks.label: ex:bounded-operator-extension-spectral-inclusions

blocks.en: Let\[\mathcal{D}(A)=\{u\in H^2(0,1)\mid u(0)=u(1)=0\}.\]Define the operator $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ from $L^2(0,1)$ to $L^2(0,1)$ by\[Au=u''\]for $u\in\mathcal{D}(A)$. Show that $\sigma(A)$ is not compact. Does your answer contradict Corollary~\ref{cor:bounded-operator-spectrum-compact}?
